peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 68.2% above its local comparables; 142 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (27.9): 2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 111 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: Freehold.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 4-bedroom: median $12,375,000 ($4,290 psf, 2,884 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,551 psf (range $2,104–3,576); 68.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $5,016,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard MRT about 710 m, Newton MRT about 960 m; closer than 50 of 551 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Primary) about 1,100 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 330 m), more than 344 of 551 similar developments (the same as 74); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 1,130 m; nearest park Sbg Lc Zone 1 (Tnc) about 1,220 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 280 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 880 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 960 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,130 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,190 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,320 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,470 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,800 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 383 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 119 new sales and 1,011 resales (1,130 purchases); new sales were 10.5% of these purchases. Subsales (25) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 840 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 900 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,011 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 277 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,011 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,065 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.1%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
